t: This is 102 Eaton Square, a Grade II star listed house in Belgravia, in central London. That listing means it's considered a building of particular importance. It was owned by Andrey Goncharenko, a Russian businessman and former chief executive of a Gazprom subsidiary. He owned four central London houses, bought for a total of two hundred and fifty million pounds, including Hanover Lodge, which was described as the UK's most expensive home. So this house belongs to a wider story of very high-value London property.
